by
  intro E F _ _ _ _ _ f L a hf hL
  have hs := hf.hasStrictFDerivAt' hL one_ne_zero
  exact ⟨hf.localInverse hL one_ne_zero, hf.localInverse_apply_image hL one_ne_zero,
    hs.eventually_left_inverse, hs.eventually_right_inverse,
    hs.to_localInverse.hasFDerivAt, hf.to_localInverse hL one_ne_zero⟩
target_source: ∀ (E F : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (f : E → F) (L : E ≃L[ℝ] F) (a : E), ContDiffAt ℝ 1 f a → HasFDerivAt f (L : E →L[ℝ] F) a → ∃ g : F → E, g (f a) = a ∧ (∀ᶠ x in nhds a, g (f x) = x) ∧ (∀ᶠ y in nhds (f a), f (g y) = y) ∧ HasFDerivAt g (L.symm : F →L[ℝ] E) (f a) ∧ ContDiffAt ℝ 1 g (f a)
